title: OpenWrt Firmware Lag Over Ninety Days
app: OpenWrt, UniFi, Pi-hole, AdGuard Home, Tailscale, Cloudflare Tunnel, DNS over HTTPS resolvers, and scheduled probes via syslog, APIs, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=openwrt:syslog event=firmware_check
| stats latest(days_behind_release) as days_behind_release by router
| where days_behind_release>90
| sort - days_behind_release
description: Uses OpenWrt firmware checks telemetry to monitor how far each router is behind current releases in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for gateways that have accumulated too much patch debt, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest OpenWrt firmware checks data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
visualization: Router table of days behind release.
grandmaExplanation: It turns how far each router is behind current releases so you can spot gateways that have accumulated too much patch debt before it becomes annoying.
